descriptions.zh: 启动实例全量数据导入，此时系统会创建一个数据集新版本。系统会从您的数据源中导入所有的全量数据到系统并训练。
descriptions.en: You can call this API operation to run an instance to start a full data import task. After you call this API operation, the system creates a dataset. Then, the system imports all data from your data sources into the dataset for data training.
